description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/sec/10k-risk (base $0.05; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?cik=320193. To list a company's stated risks: Item 1A risk headings from its latest original 10-K by CIK, as written, grouped by section, with the filing link. Extracted, not rewritten. USDC on Base or Polygon. Data from SEC EDGAR; not affiliated with or endorsed by the SEC. Not financial, investment, tax, legal or health advice. Quotes about tokens, securities or other financial products are not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold anything. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests are not charged.
